connectivity.title: Connectivity
connectivity.description: Every time Polaris lost its connection or could not be reached from outside, and for how long.

kindHints.line: Nothing answered, and the public resolvers Polaris checks were silent too.
kindHints.dns: The internet worked, but the public address's name did not resolve.
kindHints.address: The internet worked, but nothing answered at the public address.

state.title: Right now
state.lineBack: The internet came back at {time}; the public address still does not answer.
state.unwatched: Not checked since {time}. Polaris was not running checks, so this is the last thing it knows.
state.never: Not checked yet. The first check runs a minute after Polaris starts.
state.cadence: Checked every {interval}, and every {close} while something is down. Outages less than {gap} apart count as one.
state.cadenceNoMerge: Checked every {interval}, and every {close} while something is down. Every outage is counted on its own.
